web.title: Cosmos Reason2 Models on Jetson
web.description:
# Cosmos Reason2 Models on Jetson
Both models are available in quantized formats (FP8 for vLLM, FP4/other GGUF variants for llama.cpp) and can be served on Jetson.

## Step 4: Serve Cosmos Reason2 with vLLM
```
docker run --rm -it \
  --runtime nvidia \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=8g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -v "$MODEL_PATH:/models/cosmos-reason2:ro" \
  -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all \
  -e NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility \
  ghcr.io/nvidia-ai-iot/vllm:latest-jetson-thor \
  bash
```

```
cd /opt/
source venv/bin/activate

vllm serve /models/cosmos-reason2 \
  --max-model-len 8192 \
  --media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"num_frames": -1}}' \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8
```

```
cd /opt/
source venv/bin/activate

vllm serve /models/cosmos-reason2 \
  --max-model-len 8192 \

  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8
```

# vLLM brings FP8 inference to the open source community
### vLLM now supports FP8 on NVIDIA GPUs
With FP8, vLLM deployments may receive up to a 2x reduction in latency with minimal accuracy degradation.

## FP8 performance in vLLM
- **Throughput**: The number of output tokens per second an inference server can generate across all users and requests. Higher throughput allows for serving more requests simultaneously.
